object: Austrian-Dutch physicist (1880–1933). The conference gadfly who asked devastating questions that cut to the bone. Close friends with both Einstein and Bohr — one of the few who could bridge their divide. Known for the Ehrenfest theorem linking classical and quantum mechanics. Killed his disabled son and himself six years later.
